scenes.title: 2010 Harvard BIDMC Clinic Desk: Handing Over the Amber Bottle Boldly Labeled 'Placebo Pills'
scenes.era: 2010, Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center consultation room, Boston, Massachusetts

layout.description: Sunlit Boston hospital consultation desk with a large amber pharmacy bottle printed with a crisp white 'PLACEBO PILLS' label, two blue-and-white cellulose capsules resting on a small ceramic dish, a clear glass water tumbler, and a 0-to-10 clinical pain-relief clipboard.

positions.who: Harvard clinician (2.5D matte cream-white vinyl adult physician in tailored navy blazer and white clinical coat)
positions.where: seated across the consultation desk sliding the amber 'Placebo Pills' bottle forward with an open palm while explaining the capsules hold zero active medicine

positions.who: Midlife patient (47-year-old 2.5D matte cream-white vinyl adult in smart-casual olive cardigan and collared shirt)
positions.where: lifting the amber bottle to eye level, tipping two inert capsules into an open palm, and raising the water glass

props.name: amber pharmacy pill bottle with bold white placebo label and two blue-and-white capsules
props.period_detail: standard clinical prescription bottle openly disclosing inert cellulose contents with zero deception
props.physical_behavior: State-A closed upright on the oak desk -> State-B uncapped in the patient's hand tipping two capsules cleanly into an open palm

props.name: clear glass water tumbler and clinical symptom-relief clipboard
props.period_detail: everyday morning-and-evening pill-swallowing ritual paired with 21-day IBS and 0-to-10 back-pain tracking sheet
props.physical_behavior: State-A resting full beside the dish -> State-B lifted smoothly to the mouth as shoulders drop out of guarded tension

actions.verb_sequence: places the amber placebo bottle squarely on the desk -> points openly to the inert-ingredients card -> nods calmly as the patient inspects the bottle
unscrews the white cap -> taps two inert capsules into palm -> swallows with water and exhales as abdominal and lower-back tension softens

reactions.reaction: wry skeptical raised eyebrow shifting into genuine physical relief as cramped posture unclenches
warm, transparent clinical composure recording the 59% vs 35% relief outcome

scenes.wardrobe: 2010 Boston clinical attire: crisp white physician coat over navy blazer and tie; adult patient in olive knit cardigan, Oxford shirt, and dark chinos.
scenes.lighting: Bright high-key New England hospital window daylight across warm oak desk and amber glass.
scenes.recognition_hook: The doctor tells you straight to your face that the bottle holds zero medicine — yet swallowing two honest placebo capsules twice a day still cuts real clinical pain!

key_visual.description: a Boston hospital consultation desk where a physician slides forward an amber bottle labeled Placebo Pills while an adult patient tips two capsules into hand beside a glass of water

scenes.title: 2016 Chronic Back-Pain Morning Walk: Sunlit Outdoor Neighborhood Sidewalk Mobility Relief
scenes.era: 2016, Sunlit residential tree-lined morning sidewalk & front porch steps

layout.description: Open-air sunlit neighborhood brick walkway and porch steps in crisp morning daylight where a 52-year-old adult sets down a morning water mug on the porch rail and bends smoothly to pick up the morning newspaper without lower-back guarding.

positions.who: 52-year-old adult back-pain volunteer (in casual quilted vest and walking shoes)
positions.where: stepping briskly down outdoor porch stairs onto the sunlit tree-lined sidewalk and bending comfortably to lift a canvas grocery tote

props.name: canvas morning tote bag on sunlit outdoor porch steps
props.period_detail: everyday adult functional mobility test mirroring the Roland-Morris back-disability improvement in Carvalho et al. (2016)
props.physical_behavior: State-A resting at the base of the outdoor steps -> State-B lifted smoothly to waist height with an unguarded upright spine

actions.verb_sequence: steps out onto the sunlit porch -> bends smoothly at knees and hips to lift the canvas tote -> strides comfortably down the open sidewalk

reactions.reaction: pleasantly surprised smile touching lower back lightly as usual morning stiffness stays quiet

scenes.wardrobe: Adult smart-casual outdoor attire: navy quilted vest over heather crew shirt, khaki trousers, walking sneakers.
scenes.lighting: Warm golden morning sunlight filtering across open neighborhood trees, brick porch, and sidewalk.
scenes.recognition_hook: Three weeks of honest twice-daily cellulose capsules helped chronic back-pain adults bend, walk, and carry groceries outdoors with nearly 30% less pain.

scenes.title: 2020 Non-Deceptive Saline Spray EEG Lab: Objective Neural Distress Wave Dropping Live
scenes.era: 2020, University affective neuroscience EEG suite (Guevarra, Moser, Wager & Kross)

layout.description: Clean sunlit university neurophysiology room where an adult participant wearing a soft 64-channel EEG cap administers a clearly labeled 'Inert Saline Placebo Spray' before viewing emotional stimulus cards while an adjacent waveform monitor shows the Late Positive Potential curve dropping.

positions.who: Adult EEG volunteer (in grey crewneck sweater wearing soft EEG sensor cap)
positions.where: seated upright holding the clearly marked inert saline nasal bottle on the desk while watching stimulus cards calmly
standing beside the EEG waveform console comparing the high control distress wave against the dampened open-placebo wave

props.name: inert saline nasal spray bottle and dual EEG distress-waveform board
props.period_detail: captures Guevarra et al.'s (2020) non-deceptive nasal spray protocol and Late Positive Potential (LPP) drop
props.physical_behavior: State-A jagged high distress trace -> State-B settled low waveform amplitude within milliseconds

actions.verb_sequence: presents emotional test card after honest saline spray -> points to the flattened Late Positive Potential peak on the console

reactions.reaction: steady breathing and relaxed jaw proving genuine psychobiological dampening rather than polite reporting

scenes.wardrobe: Modern university lab attire: crisp lab coat over collared shirt; soft grey cotton pullover.
scenes.recognition_hook: An EEG cap catches the brain's involuntary distress wave shrinking in real time — proving honest placebos aren't just polite answers on a survey.
